name: The Group's knowledge system derives truth from marks, mathematics and standards, holds all data as subject-predicate-object, and lets attention raise a resource's care
asks: Leader utterances of 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-25 (pass general-1): all data is SPO; knowledge graphs are meshy DAGs; formal concept analysis is built from marks outward; truth is derived by mathematics, standards conformance and research and not by human ruling; attention percolates a resource toward better care; grade annotations are derived, not handwritten; ordinals and fractions are preferred over integers; Thing and Cell are distinct types.

x-provenance.recorded-by: general-1 pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Leader utterances of 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-25 (pass general-1): all data is SPO; knowledge graphs are meshy DAGs; formal concept analysis is built from marks outward; truth is derived by mathematics, standards conformance and research and not by human ruling; attention percolates a resource toward better care; grade annotations are derived, not handwritten; ordinals and fractions are preferred over integers; Thing and Cell are distinct types.

requirements.says: The knowledge system shall represent all data as subject-predicate-object triples, including a file's key and value as the triple (file, key, value).
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 19:51 and 2026-09-25 17:50: "all data in existence is SPO"; "(File, key, value) is (SPO) ... (token, claim) is (s, o) with an unsaturated function".

requirements.says: The knowledge system shall hold its graph as a meshy directed acyclic graph in which the key that supplies the function of a claim is itself a term.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 17:50: "key provides the function, but itself is another term so we end up with a meshy DAG".

requirements.says: The knowledge system shall build its formal concept analysis from bare marks outward, so that the more settled the corpus is, the more confidently truth is derived from it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 17:41: "we want to do FCA from bare principles (marks) outward".

requirements.says: The knowledge system shall decide what is correct by mathematics, standards conformance and research, and shall take no single source, including a human ruling, as authoritative.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 16:00 and 17:41: "you MUST use mathematics, standards conformance, and actual research, to decide what is 'correct'"; the ruling concept "reinforces the idea of a supreme human in the loop, rather than a mesh of humans and agents seeking mathematical lawfulness".

requirements.says: The knowledge system shall derive the provenance, grade and relation annotations of a record from its graphing tools and shall not carry them as handwritten text or hand-maintained relative links.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 17:41: "derived via our graphing tools, not something hardcoded or handwritten ... the constant '[grade]' stuff is complete theater"; 2026-09-21 01:39: relative links kept by hand are "stupid".

requirements.says: The knowledge system shall record how often humans open a resource's page and shall use that attention to prompt its systems to raise the resource to the best state they can reach.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 17:41: "if humans keep opening a note's page and we're tracking those page views, that motivates our systems to go make sure that resource is as good as we can get it".

requirements.says: The knowledge system shall be built with OWL, SPARQL and the graphing tools available to the house, and not as a search over markdown files.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-21 01:39: "where is our owl, sparql, why do you act like having something that's basically grep over some markdown files is a knowledge system????"; FORD is not assumed to be the right taxonomy.

requirements.says: The knowledge system shall generate Turtle and similar representations from the schema and shall carry no handwritten copy of data already held in a schema.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 03:07: "we have systems somewhere for like, generating ttl from schema, i want schema ... not more hand written copies of the same data".

requirements.says: The Daoist studies shall be richer, denser, more machine-readable and more useful to knowledge graphing and to forming an OWL, using the house's upstream code and not Daoist-only projection code.
The Group's science research shall be made more legible, visible and machine-readable by improving the tools already in use.
The Group's numeric representation shall prefer ordinals and fractions over integers, each use of an integer being justified by its context.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 23:13: "Generally we want ordinals, fractions, over integers".

requirements.says: The Thing data structure shall be distinct from the Cell data structure, a Thing having qualities, relations, structures and conditions as its subobjects.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12 01:35: "Thing is a completely different data structure ... they're not the same object, cells and things"; the list of subobjects is doubted.

requirements.says: The Group's software shall use one identifier system, introduced by breaking migration.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12 01:35: "breaking migrations to one ID system across all our software, and fix that fourth duplicate".

requirements.says: The Group's content normalization shall be measured against what the Group's theory supports for knowledge graphing, truth and evidence, and shall not take normalized frontmatter alone as progress.
